tweets.text:
I commend the Trump Administration for its leadership in delivering billions of dollars to strengthen rural health care nationwide as part of the One Big Beautiful Bill. 

Unfortunately, the Moore administration failed to adequately prioritize Maryland’s application by not applying for a SNAP nutritious food waiver, causing our rural communities to miss out on additional millions of dollars that would have been flowing into our state. 

As a physician and representative of a rural district — and the only member of Maryland’s congressional delegation to support the passage of these rural healthcare funds, I’m ready to work with the Trump Administration to address the needs of rural Marylanders with these dollars.
